text:
ali-peopleops: Heads-up — new hire @michael L. onboarding 4/1 remote. Passport is delayed in transit and BG vendor flagged a possible alias. Need to triage I-9 path + whether we ship the welcome kit/laptop. Who can own?

sarah-ops: Can you DM me dob + last4 so I can check vendor notes? If passport arrives within 72h we can do remote I-9 affidavit, otherwise kiosk.

ali-peopleops: DOB 1993-08-14, last4 4321. Passport ETA Fri ~3pm (tracking: https://www.ups.com/track/1Z999AA10123456784). BG vendor notes: "possible alias/mismatch" — they asked for gov ID + signed consent form.

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK UPDATE: Michael L. — status: manual review. Requested docs sent 1764011000.

anna-peopleops: We can reserve a kiosk in SF if he can come by. @mike-it can you open a badge pickup slot? Also question: do we want to ship laptop now or hold until identity is cleared? New hire prefers remote first week.

mike-it: Reserved SF kiosk Mon 09:30. Laptop shipping policy: usually ship T-1 after offer accept. If BG flagged, we can either 1) ship with signature-required courier hold, or 2) hold until ID verified. Recommend hold unless Michael signs a waiver.

ali-peopleops: He explicitly said he'd rather not come onsite first week. Is there a policy/precedent for remote I-9 when passport is "in transit" but vendor needs doc copy?

sarah-ops: Policy snippet: remote I-9 OK if employer uses an authorized agent OR ID arrives within 3 business days and we document the exception. See I-9 remote exception form: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/i9-remote-exception. If vendor requests additional consent, have candidate email scanned ID + handwritten consent. We'll attach to BG file.

anna-peopleops: I'll draft the email to Michael. Template below — use this when you send: 
```
Subject: Quick steps to finish your onboarding (I-9 + BG)
Hi Michael,
Thanks — quick follow-ups so we can complete your background check and I-9: 
1) Please upload a photo of any government-issued ID (passport or driver’s license) to this secure link: https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire
2) Reply to this email with a short signed consent line: "I, Michael L., authorize Redwood Inference to process background check materials."
3) If you can swing by SF kiosk Mon 09:30 we can complete I-9 in person; otherwise we will use the remote-affidavit process and you must provide the ID within 3 business days.
Thanks — Ali (People Ops)
```

ali-peopleops: I'll send that now and put laptop on hold pending ID. Can someone confirm courier hold instructions if we need to ship?

mike-it: Use XPO hold code: "HOLD-REDACT" and require recipient photo ID on delivery. I can add a note to the shipping manifest. If Michael signs consent and uploads ID, we can change to ship same-day.

anna-peopleops: Filed kiosk reservation and added a calendar invite. I'll update BG vendor with expected docs and timeline.

ali-peopleops: thanks all — I'll coordinate with Michael and update here. :thumbsup:
